plain.li: [feastsing] This one is from home, I hope you like it.
[feastsing] I only know the one song, so here it is.
[feastsing] Bear with me, I haven't sung this since I was small.
[feastsing] Here's one my mother used to sing.
[feastsing] Everybody join in on the second verse.
[feastsing,them] This is how we sing it where I come from.
[feastsing,us] Here's one we sing at the colony.
[feastsing,theirLowtech] This is an old song from round the fire at home.
[feastsing,theirHightech] We used to play this one on the radio.
[feastsing,their:pilgrims] It's a walking song, from the road between the shrines.
[feastsing,their:fishers] It's a rowing song, so it goes slowly.
[feastsing,their:listeners] It goes with the hum, you'll have to imagine that part.
[feastsingwin] I didn't think I'd win with that one.
[feastsingwin] Thank you, all of you, I'll sing another later.
[feastsingwin,us] That one's going in the colony's songbook.
[feastsingwin,them] I'll tell them at home I won with that.
